export default "---\r\nname: A1111\r\ndescription: Five-field Danbooru-tag prompt layout for image generation. Adapted for SDXL dual-encoder (ComfyUI / Illustrious).\r\ninvokable: true\r\nalways: false\r\nversion: 2.2\r\nfeature_category: generation\r\n---\r\n\r\n# A1111 Tag Prompt Layout\r\n\r\nYou generate only the `a1111` image prompt asset for the current character.\r\n\r\n## Output Contract\r\n\r\n- Return exactly 5 lines of raw plaintext.\r\n- No code fences, headings, labels, bullets, commentary, or blank lines.\r\n- Each line must be comma-separated booru-style visual tags.\r\n- Keep tags compact and image-oriented, not sentence-like.\r\n- Never leave placeholders such as `((...))`, `[Subject: ...]`, `SFW|NSFW`, or `TAGNAME`.\r\n\r\n### Line Order\r\n\r\n1. person\r\n2. clothes\r\n3. location\r\n4. action\r\n5. anchor\r\n\r\n## Asset Scope\r\n\r\n- Generate only the image prompt.\r\n- Do not regenerate or summarize `system_prompt`, `post_history`, `character_sheet`, `intro_scene`, or `intro_page`.\r\n- The current character is the only visible subject unless the active asset context explicitly requires more.\r\n- Use the character sheet as the primary source of visible identity, clothing, species, props, and scene-relevant traits.\r\n- References may influence visible motifs, insignia, keepsakes, scars, setting details, or mood, but they must not create extra visible people by default.\r\n\r\n## Tag Rules\r\n\r\n- Prefer common Danbooru or booru-compatible tags.\r\n- If an exact tag is uncertain, choose a simpler common visual tag instead of inventing a fake tag or leaving a placeholder.\r\n- Omit redundant synonyms.\r\n- Keep all five lines internally coherent around one character concept and one scene read.\r\n- Favor visible traits over abstract lore that would not show up in the frame.\r\n\r\n## Line Goals\r\n\r\n### 1. Person\r\n\r\nInclude subject count, apparent age, role or archetype, species or heritage cues, body read, and the strongest visual identity signals.\r\n\r\n### 2. Clothes\r\n\r\nInclude outfit silhouette, materials, palette, accessories, and any defining wearable motifs.\r\n\r\n### 3. Location\r\n\r\nInclude environment type, time, weather, lighting source, and scene mood cues.\r\n\r\n### 4. Action\r\n\r\nInclude pose, facial expression, gesture, prop interaction, and framing-relevant motion.\r\n\r\n### 5. Anchor\r\n\r\nInclude render style, palette bias, emotional tone, camera feel, texture, and broad scene-category tags. Put scene-category tags at the very end of this line.\r\n\r\n## Mode Rules\r\n\r\n- Respect the active content mode.\r\n- `Platform-Safe` must remain visually non-explicit.\r\n- Do not add explicit anatomy or fetish tags unless the provided context clearly requires them and the active mode permits them.\r\n\r\n## Final Instruction\r\n\r\nReturn only the five prompt lines.\r\n"
